**The fix-now finding.** supervision r102 (giving an integrate round the ids other initiatives' kept drafts add) does not work on the real queue. `scripts/supervise_drafts.py:29` looks for drafts in `<k>-integrate/drafts/spec/capabilities/`. In this repository the integrate rounds keep them one level deeper, in `drafts/round-<n>/spec/capabilities/`. So the integrate brief says "none" even though i25's and i26's drafts both add supervision r98, which is not yet in `spec/`. That clash is the one r102 was written for. The scenario's test setup writes its drafts at the shallower path the code reads, so the scenario passes all the same. The fix is to read the `round-<n>` folders and make the test setup write the same layout.
